transcript.text: Back in 2025 when I was in Chongqing, I remember chatting with locals about which clinics people usually go to—randomly stuck with me.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Around that same stretch, I kept hearing Wuhan come up because my cousin had been hopping around there for live events and shows.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: And yeah, Chongqing food was basically the whole trip—everyone kept pointing me to different neighborhoods for places to eat.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: I also remember looking up some basic cold meds back then, just to understand what the labels meant, nothing dramatic.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: My friend Luo Fei had an appointment already set up with Dr. Peng Hui for the morning on 2025-05-09—she told me afterward it went smoothly.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: The booking was under the patient name Luo Fei, which made me laugh because the clinic kept calling the name out super formally.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Oh, and David Liu once told me he’d already gotten 5 tickets for the JJ Lin Concert in Stand A, and the buyer phone he used was 13888990011; separate thing, Xie Peng had a table at Liuyishou Hotpot on 2025-03-02 at 14:00 for 3 people, with 13851574217 as the contact number.
